about: The follower's gains and limits: the one source (contract 8, docs/phase0.md). Teleop writes them to every servo on start, reads them back and refuses to run if one differs, and records what it read in every session header. P/I/D: the factory 32/0/32, which stop within 0.4-0.7 deg (2026-11-23; LeRobot's P 16 stops up to 2.3 deg short). max_torque, 0-1000 = 0-100%: about 1.2x the most each joint used in Hanoi moves at step limit 20 (2026-11-23); the gripper at 30%, since 50% flung discs (2026-11-24). gripper: LeRobot's burnout guard (protection current in 6.5 mA units; overload torque in percent).
